bounds.domain: Cold priority selection and its synchronous preview, including eligibility at the selection completion clock.
limitations: Two providers and three accounts, with the same visible id in both providers. Three cold priority calls, at most one pending call, a singleton or absent allowlist and exclusion, and a stable inventory order. Preview supports the allowlist and no exclusion.

The completion clock has values0..2. A known cooldown and an optional subscription expiry use time1. An unknown cooldown and parked health remain unavailable. Enabled flags and health snapshots stay fixed while a call waits.

At most one priority update per account in the primary provider and one recorded-use change. Last-use values represent ordinal recency. These updates occur between calls. The source-linked AccountPoolHealth model covers expiry write guards and generation-aware metadata effects.

Two logical storage roots model the pool's captured policy and an independently changing ambient state directory. Credential lookup records only its store identity. The linked real encrypted-store test checks Claude token injection and Codex materialization; token refresh and credential failure are covered by the separate health and broker models.

Session affinity, alternate ranking strategies, concurrent metadata writers during the expiry await, failed expiry writes, account replacement, arbitrary lists and complete credential resolution are outside this case.

assumptions: Weak fairness of finish settles an admitted priority call. Its expiry check completes successfully and there is no process death.
Expiry write failure, caller cancellation and wall-clock scheduler guarantees are outside this case. Preview completes synchronously.
